thread:
alice: FYI follow-ups from the postmortem — we saw TLS edge flaps + route reshuffles causing cross-region retries. Need owners and timelines.
ben: ack. do we have the exact rollback window from the incident?
alice: yes — incident window ~1805121200-1805122600. root cause: dual-homed edge LB briefly advertising stale origin routes after cert rotation.
carol: happy to own the routing remediation (LB config + advert timing). will coordinate with infra.
dmitri: i can own TLS rotation hardening (cert sequencer + graceful drain).
ops-bot: [alert] Incident 2024-11-19 14:12 — LB evict/flap detected, link: https://rwd-infra/alerts/17999 :eyes:
ben: thanks. can you both post a short action list here w/ owners + ETA? ops needs the dates for ticketing.
carol: action 1: Add 10s post-rotation wait before BGP/route advertise (owner: carol, eta: 2024-11-26). action 2: add config flag to disable parallel advert during rolling certs (owner: carol, eta: 2024-12-03).
 dmitri: action 3: sequencer change to emit 'drain_complete' event only after active connections=0 (owner: dmitri, eta: 2024-11-24). action 4: add monitoring rule for pre/post rotation route Delta > 0.5s (owner: dmitri, eta: 2024-11-28).
alice: add action 5: temporary routing fallback policy to prefer regional stable edges for 72h after a rotation (owner: alice, eta: 2024-11-22). this is a short mitigation we can ship fast.
elaine: can we get a canary plan for these changes? i want to avoid blast radius.
carol: yes — plan: 1% pop -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h with automatic rollback on >0.3% retry increase. i'll write the rollout steps in the ticket.
ben: please include exact dashboards and alert thresholds for rollback. ops will wire the alerts.
dmitri: note: this pattern (rotation -> brief route advert gap -> retries) showed up twice in last 90 days. we should add it to recurring-incident tracker and schedule a 3mo audit.
alice: agreed. can someone update the postmortem doc with the owner table + ETA and link the new tickets? i'll close loop with customer success.
carol: created ticket INFRA-4821 with remediation checklist + canary steps. link: https://rwd-issues/INFRA-4821 (ETA fields filled).
dmitri: created ticket SEC-2992 for sequencer change and monitor rule. link: https://rwd-issues/SEC-2992.
ops-bot: [workflow] INFRA-4821 assigned to carol, due 2024-11-26. SEC-2992 assigned to dmitri, due 2024-11-24.
elaine: i'll update the runbook (playbook section) and add the quick mitigation (alice's fallback). eta runbook update: 2024-11-23.
ben: owners + ETAs look good. can we add a weekly check-in for these items until they're closed? 15-min sync on Thursdays?
alice: yes — schedule recurring Thursdays 10:30 for 4 weeks. invites sent.
carol: quick config snippet i'll add to ticket for the post-rotation wait: ```
# lb.conf
rotation:
  post_rotate_delay_ms: 10000
  advertise_after_delay: true
```
dmitri: also adding a small histogram metric `rotation_route_delta_ms` and alert when p95 > 50ms.
elaine: thanks everyone. please comment in the tickets when PRs are open so ops can validate telemetry. :thumbsup:
ben: closing this thread for now — ping here if any ETA slides. thanks!
